title: triticum dicoccum var. atratum
intro: Triticum dicoccum var. atratum, commonly known as Kamut, is an ancient type of emmer wheat. This plant is known for its high nutritional value and is often used as a food source. The health benefits of Kamut include its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Kamut are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include fiber, vitamins, and minerals, as well as other compounds such as avenanthramides, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
